scenes.text: Imagine opening up the most sacred book on earth, only to find out that committing a major, unforgivable sin was actually a direct, written command sent straight from the heavens above.

Back in 1631, a prestigious royal printing house in London made a catastrophic typo, accidentally omitting the crucial word 'not' from the Ten Commandments and literally instructing everyone to commit adultery.
Once the furious king finally discovered this massive, blasphemous blunder, he instantly ordered every single copy of this sinful Bible to be tracked down, confiscated, and publicly burned.
With only fifteen of these incredibly rare 'Wicked Bibles' surviving today, each original copy is now worth a massive fortune, so would you ever keep one? Follow for more crazy history!
